            Proof points for the client

              Middleton Method

              Log the role, its hiring managers and the candidate you're sending over. Save the entry, then copy it from your saved entries straight into your tracking sheet.

              Example entry, clear to start
              It reads it as soon as you paste: every job, every hiring manager once, the candidates, and every date it finds. Dates in a manager's row count for that manager; dates on the company row count for everyone on that job.
              THE ROLE

              Company & position

              Required before saving.
              Becomes a clickable link on the position cell.
              CONTACTS

              Hiring managers

              Saved entries

              Select Copy (or Copy all), click the cell where the block should start in Excel or Google Sheets, and paste. Borders, bold, the merged position cell and the job link come with it.

              Saved in this browser only. Your spreadsheet is still the record.

              Candidate Notes

              Take notes during the candidate call, then copy them into the CRM notes.

              The Fit score prompt on the Candidate Match tab writes these. Up to 15.

                Job Spec

                Take notes on the role, then copy them into the CRM notes.

                Copy to ChatGPT ↗
                Copies the questions from the spec you're using (Speed Spec or Job Spec Sheet), your notes and the transcript. ChatGPT answers every question from the call and lists anything that still wasn't covered.

                Candidate Sourcing

                Line up the people you find for a job, then copy them straight into your sourcing sheet.

                Select Copy on a candidate, click the Need to Call cell on their row in your sheet, and paste. It fills Need to Call through Notes. The matched job stays here and doesn't copy over.
